footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Cinemark: after $1.6M of preferred dividends. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.1% to $3.1B in 2025. Operating income fell 39.1% to $154M, a 4.9% margin.
Net income fell 55.1% to $137M, or $1.04 per share. Operating cash flow was $0 and free cash flow $0, versus $0.
